label: Gala — Ocelot

sprite.name: REVOLVER OCELOT — MGS1
sprite.incarnation: Revolver Ocelot of original MGS1, recognizable aged angular human face and moustache, long silver-gray hair tied back, no eyepatch or hat. Original western evening tuxedo: tailored long black formal tailcoat/dinner coat with satin peaked lapels and two separated coat tails, rich oxblood waistcoat, white collar shirt, small black bow tie, discreet silver pocket-watch chain, charcoal formal trousers, brown polished western boots, original brown leather low gunbelt/holster. Preserve the exact silver Colt Single Action Army revolver design, revolver cylinder and barrel in the exact source hand and pose, never a semiautomatic pistol or two copies of the gun. Distinct experienced gunslinger formal silhouette.
